description: Create the three new source modules and mock helper: streamContractEventsRealTime.ts, decodeContractEvent.ts, eventIndex.ts, and src/testing/mockEventStream.ts. Also extend src/soroban/types.ts with DecodedContractEvent / StreamContractEventsOptions / EventIndexFilter, and update barrel exports in src/soroban/index.ts and src/testing/index.ts.
steps: 1. Modify src/soroban/types.ts — append three interfaces at the end of the file (after ParsedContractResult): DecodedContractEvent { contractId: string; name: string; topics: string[]; value: unknown; raw: unknown; type: string; }, StreamContractEventsOptions { horizonUrl: string; intervalMs?: number; maxBackoffMs?: number; fetch?: typeof fetch; onEvent: (events: ContractEvent[]) => void; onError?: (err: Error, attempt: number) => void; onReconnect?: (attempt: number) => void; }, EventIndexFilter { contractId?: string; name?: string; topics?: string[]; minLedger?: number; maxLedger?: number; predicate?: (event: ContractEvent) => boolean; }. Import ContractEvent from './subscribeContractEvents' at top of types.ts (or use 'import type').

2. Create src/soroban/streamContractEventsRealTime.ts — implement streamContractEventsRealTime(contractId: string, filter: ContractEventFilter | undefined, options: StreamContractEventsOptions): { stop: () => void }. Import ContractEvent, ContractEventFilter from './subscribeContractEvents'; import StreamContractEventsOptions from './types'. Internal pattern: let backoffMs = options.intervalMs ?? 1500; const maxBackoff = options.maxBackoffMs ?? 60_000; let attempt = 0; let active = true; let timer. scheduleNext() sets timer to setTimeout(poll, backoffMs). poll(): if !active return; try fetch horizonUrl/ledgers (same endpoint pattern as subscribeContractEvents); on success reset backoffMs to base interval and attempt=0, filter events with seenIds Set, call options.onEvent; on any error call options.onError?.(err, attempt), if attempt>0 call options.onReconnect?.(attempt), increment attempt, double backoffMs (cap at maxBackoff), then schedule. stop(): active=false, clearTimeout(timer). Use readRecords helper (copy from subscribeContractEvents.ts inline — do not import from it to avoid future circular dep issues) or import directly since no circularity exists. Re-export nothing from types, just use the import.

3. Create src/soroban/decodeContractEvent.ts — implement decodeContractEvent(rawEvent: unknown, abi?: ContractAbi): SorokitResult<DecodedContractEvent>. Import ok, err, SorokitErrorCode from '../shared/response'; import DecodedContractEvent, ContractAbi from './types'; import decodeContractValue from './contractEncoding'. Guard: typeof rawEvent !== 'object' || rawEvent === null → return err(SorokitErrorCode.CONTRACT_READ_FAILED, 'malformed event: expected an object'). Normalise: extract contractId = String(raw.contractId ?? raw.contract_id ?? ''), name = String(raw.name ?? raw.event_type ?? ''), topics = Array.isArray(raw.topics) ? [...] : [], rawValue = raw.value. ABI lookup: if abi provided, check if name is in abi.methods (ContractAbiObject shape) or abi.functions (ContractAbiFunctionObject shape); matched → type='known', attempt decodeContractValue on rawValue if it has a .switch() method (duck-type check), else pass through; unmatched → type='unknown', pass rawValue through. No ABI → type='unknown', attempt decodeContractValue if duck-type check passes. Wrap all in try/catch → err(CONTRACT_READ_FAILED, error.message). Return ok({ contractId, name, topics, value: decodedValue, raw: rawEvent, type }).

4. Create src/soroban/eventIndex.ts — implement EventIndex class. Internal: primary = new Map<string, ContractEvent>(); collisions = new Map<string, ContractEvent[]>(). djb2 hash: function hash(s: string): string { let h = 5381; for (let i=0; i<s.length; i++) h = ((h << 5) + h) ^ s.charCodeAt(i); return (h >>> 0).toString(16); }. hashKey(e: ContractEvent): string = hash(String(e.id??'') + ':' + String(e.contractId??'') + ':' + String((e as any).ledger??'') + ':' + String(e.name??'')). fullKey(e): string = String(e.id??'') + '|' + String(e.contractId??'') + '|' + String((e as any).ledger??''). add(event): h=hashKey(event); if !primary.has(h): primary.set(h, event); else: existing=primary.get(h); if fullKey(existing)===fullKey(event) return; collisions.get(h)??collisions.set(h,[]).get(h)!.push(event). query(filter): collect all events (primary values + all collision arrays), apply filter fields. For topics filter: check if event.topics includes any of filter.topics. For ledger: access (event as any).ledger. deduplicate(): iterate all events, key by fullKey, keep first seen, rebuild primary, clear collisions, return removed count. size(): primary.size + sum of collisions map values lengths. clear(): primary.clear(); collisions.clear(). Import ContractEvent from './subscribeContractEvents'; EventIndexFilter from './types'.

5. Update src/soroban/index.ts — add after the existing subscribeContractEvents export line: export { streamContractEventsRealTime } from './streamContractEventsRealTime'; export { decodeContractEvent } from './decodeContractEvent'; export { EventIndex } from './eventIndex'; and in the 'export type' block for types.ts add DecodedContractEvent, StreamContractEventsOptions, EventIndexFilter.

6. Create src/testing/mockEventStream.ts — implement createMockContractEventGenerator and createMockEventStream. NO vitest import in this file (it's a pure helper). createMockContractEventGenerator(options?: { seed?: number; contractId?: string; eventTypes?: string[]; topicPool?: string[] }): { next(): ContractEvent; batch(n: number): ContractEvent[] } — internal counter starts at options.seed??1, each next() call: counter++, return { id: 'event-'+counter, contractId: options.contractId??'CMOCK', name: eventTypes[counter % eventTypes.length], topics: [topicPool[counter % topicPool.length]], value: { amount: counter }, ledger: counter }. createMockEventStream(events: ContractEvent[], options?: { disconnectAfter?: number; reconnectDelay?: number }): (url: string) => Promise<Response> — internal fetchCount=0, failCount=0; on each call: fetchCount++; if options.disconnectAfter is set and fetchCount > options.disconnectAfter and failCount < (options.reconnectDelay??2): failCount++; throw new Error('Network disconnected'); else reset failCount; return a minimal Response-like object { ok: true, json: async () => ({ _embedded: { records: events } }) } as unknown as Response.

7. Update src/testing/index.ts — add: export { createMockContractEventGenerator, createMockEventStream } from './mockEventStream'; export type { MockContractEventGeneratorOptions, MockEventStreamOptions } from './mockEventStream'; (add the option interfaces to mockEventStream.ts as well).
acceptance_criteria: npm run typecheck produces zero errors after all files are created/modified
src/soroban/streamContractEventsRealTime.ts exports streamContractEventsRealTime function with correct signature
src/soroban/decodeContractEvent.ts exports decodeContractEvent function returning SorokitResult<DecodedContractEvent>
src/soroban/eventIndex.ts exports EventIndex class with add, query, deduplicate, size, clear methods
src/soroban/index.ts barrel exports all three new modules and new types
findings: Pre-existing type errors exist in the repo (src/transaction/buildTransaction.ts missing AccountMergeOptions/retryWithBackoff/isNotFoundError/autoFetchSequence, src/index.ts missing checkTrustlines/buildBulkTrustlines exports, src/soroban/subscribeContractEvents.ts possibly-undefined options in queryContractEvents). These are NOT introduced by FEAT-001. Pre-existing test failures: (1) src/tests/transaction.test.ts has a syntax error at line 2689 that prevents the file from being parsed; (2) src/tests/account.test.ts has a flaky timing assertion in the parallel-fetch test. All 532 other tests pass including all 111 soroban tests. FEAT-002 should be aware that the new modules (streamContractEventsRealTime, decodeContractEvent, EventIndex, mockEventStream) are implemented but have no dedicated tests yet — creating those test files is the next step.
